description.zh:
作业队列。 

格式X-Y:Z， 最小值X是第一个索引，最大值Y是最后一个索引，Z表示步长，例如2-7:2，表示作业队列包含编号为2、4、6的3个子作业。
description.en:
The job array.

Format: X-Y:Z. X is the minimum index value. Y is the maximum index value. Z is the step size. For example, 2-7:2 indicates that three jobs need to be run and their index values are 2, 4, and 6.

description.zh:
作业最大运行时间，支持三种格式：
- hh:mm:ss
- mm:ss
- ss

推荐使用第一种格式。若最大运行时间为12小时，示例：12:00:00。
description.en:
The maximum running time of the job. Valid formats:

*   hh:mm:ss
*   mm:ss
*   ss

We recommend that you use the hh:mm:ss format. If the maximum running time is 12 hours, set the value to 12:00:00.

description.zh: 执行作业命令。
description.en: The command that is used to run the job.

description.zh:
单个计算节点使用GPU的数量，取值范围：1~8。

仅支持使用pbs调度器的集群，且集群内计算节点含GPU时该参数生效。
description.en:
The maximum GPU usage required by a single compute node. Valid values: 1 to 8.

The parameter takes effect only when the cluster uses PBS and a compute node is a GPU-accelerated instance.

description.zh: 已上传到OSS上的作业文件链接。
description.en: The URL of the job files that are uploaded to an Object Storage Service (OSS) bucket.

description.zh: 单个计算节点最大使用内存数，支持GB、MB、KB，单位不区分大小写。
description.en: The maximum memory usage required by a single compute node. Unit: GB, MB, or KB. The unit is case-insensitive.

description.zh:
作业模板名称。

您可以通过调用[ListJobTemplates](~~87248~~)获取待修改的模板名称。
description.en:
The name of the job template.

You can call the [ListJobTemplates](~~87248~~) operation to obtain the job template name.

description.zh:
提交作业所需计算节点数。取值范围：1~500
>若该参数为空，则参数Task、Thread、Mem、Gpu不生效。
description.en:
The number of the compute nodes. Valid values: 1 to 500.

>  If the parameter is not specified, the Task, Thread, Mem, and Gpu parameters become invalid.

description.zh: 执行作业路径。
description.en: The path that is used to run the job.

description.zh:
执行作业优先级，取值范围：0~9，取值越大，优先级越高。

默认值：0
description.en:
The priority of the job. Valid values: 0 to 9. A large value indicates a high priority.

Default value: 0

description.zh: 执行作业的队列名称。
description.en: The name of the queue.

description.zh:
是否支持重新执行作业。取值范围：
- true：支持
- false：不支持
description.en:
Specifies whether the job can be rerun. Valid values:

*   true: The job can be rerun.
*   false: The job cannot be rerun.

description.zh:
执行作业的用户名。

您可以通过调用[ListUsers](~~188572~~)获取用户名。
description.en:
The name of the user that runs the job.

You can call the [ListUsers](~~188572~~) operation to query the users of the cluster.

description.zh: 错误输出路径。
description.en: The output file path of stderr.

description.zh: 标准输出路径。
description.en: The output file path of stdout.

description.zh: 单个计算节点所需任务数。取值范围：1~1000
description.en: The number of tasks required by a single compute node. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

description.zh:
作业模板ID。

您可以通过调用[ListJobTemplates](~~87248~~)获取待修改的模板ID。
description.en:
The ID of the job template.

You can call the [ListJobTemplates](~~87248~~) operation to obtain the job template ID.

description.zh: 单个任务所需线程数。取值范围：1~1000
description.en: The number of threads required by a single compute node. Valid values: 1 to 1000.

description.zh:
解压命令，当WithUnzipCmd取值为true时，该参数生效。取值范围：

- tar xzf：解开gzip格式压缩包

- tar xf：解开tar格式压缩包

- unzip：解开zip格式压缩包
description.en:
The command that is used to decompress the job files downloaded from an OSS bucket. The parameter takes effect only when WithUnzipCmd is set to true. Valid values:

*   tar xzf: decompresses GZIP files.
*   tar xf: decompresses TAR files.
*   unzip: decompresses ZIP files.

description.zh: 执行作业的环境变量，可以在作业执行文件中访问环境变量。
description.en: The runtime variables passed to the job. They can be accessed by using environment variables in the executable file.

description.zh:
是否解压下载后的作业文件。取值范围：

- true：是

- false：否
description.en:
Specifies whether to decompress the job files downloaded from an OSS bucket. Valid values:

*   true: The job files are decompressed.
*   false: The job files are not decompressed.
